denominatorBasis: Red Electrica reported in April 2025 that 189 charging infrastructure operators had been contacted for REVE integration; replace with the live /cpos count as soon as REVE authentication is restored or a complete current public inventory is recovered.

setAsideOperators.reason: Official Powerdot FAQ states exact charging prices vary by location, charging power and site-specific fees and instructs users to consult an EMSP for the exact charger tariff. Public station pages expose station identity, connectors and QR/payment methods but not the numeric tariff; the current Electroverse Spain subscription (updated August 2026) publishes only a 29% discount for EUR 1.99/month, not an absolute station price. No non-extrapolated public base tariff could be recovered.

Current official Telpark terms publish a 30% charging discount for eligible subscribers through 31 December 2026, applicable across participating Spanish Telpark car parks, but do not publish the underlying absolute charger price. Public parking pages identify charging availability but not connector-level energy tariffs, so applying the percentage without the base price would require extrapolation.

Zunder.rule: Apply only to standard Zunder Spain EVSEs whose power/tariff class is positively established. Time-band, municipal/partner agreement and specific-location exceptions remain fail-closed until their exact station price is proven. Published ranges and 'from' prices are never used as exact tariffs.

Repsol.rule: Use only exact normal and ultra-fast Repsol-owned Spain tariffs. The fast-charge price is published as 'from 0.48 EUR/kWh' and therefore remains fail-closed rather than being extrapolated. Partner/roaming points and unresolved charge classes also remain unpriced.

Wenea.rule: Apply only to Wenea-owned Spain EVSEs in a positively established published power band. Partner/collaboration stations can vary and remain fail-closed. Wenea Everyday subscription prices are stored separately and only apply when that subscription is selected.

Eranovum.rule: Apply only to Eranovum Spain EVSEs whose power class is positively established; preserve any exact station-level price that differs from the country table. Occupancy penalties are stored separately and are not part of the base energy price.

EMT Madrid.rule: Apply only to EMT Madrid EVSEs whose official category is positively established. Preserve exact station-level prices for special hubs (including Canalejas) and leave unresolved/new hub categories fail-closed.

Plenergy (Plenoil).rule: Use 0.36 EUR/kWh only for exact station pages currently publishing the numeric charger price and matched by station identity. Do not generalize network-wide; pages with an empty charger price remain fail-closed.

ACCIONA.rule: Apply only to ACCIONA Spain EVSEs whose charger power is positively established: 0.35 EUR/kWh up to and including 22 kW, and 0.55 EUR/kWh above 22 kW. Unresolved station ownership, power, or location-specific exceptions remain fail-closed.

Endesa.rule: Apply only to positively identified Endesa public-network EVSEs in mainland Spain or the Balearic Islands with connector type/power and session start time known. Connector-specific/promotional prices shown in the app override the standard table; Canary Islands, partner/roaming EVSEs and unresolved exceptions remain fail-closed. Subscription tariffs are stored separately and only apply when selected.

inventoryNote: The earlier 20-CPO figure was a priority shortlist, not a complete national denominator. REVE states that Spain has more than 180 infrastructure operators; the 189-operator figure is retained only as the best official baseline until the current live CPO inventory can be recovered.
method: A CPO is counted treated only when an exact non-extrapolated tariff source has been made usable for at least a validated subset and all unresolved rows are explicitly fail-closed. A CPO is set aside only after official site/map, indexed public web/API/QR surfaces and useful third-party station services have been explored without obtaining a usable exact tariff source; mobile-app-only values are not inferred or reconstructed when they are not publicly exposed.
